text:
sofia (partnerships): Quick sync — Arbor asked for a focused perf/W + throughput calibration for rdx-13b using their A120 cards. Want a reproducible run and a short marketplace blurb if results look good. Keeping this thread for action items only.

ben (perf-eng): Proposal: two-tier runs. Tier1 smoke: 20m sweeps at seq=256,512,1024 with QPS ramps to find knee. Tier2 tuning: kernel-flag sweeps (single-flag at a time) + perf/W steady-state capture.

mira (eng-runtime): Telemetry needs: pmbus.power, pmbus.temp, host.rapl.package, kernel.op_ms, batch.p95, thermal.throttle events. Sampling: PMBus 10Hz, RAPL 2Hz. Will emit jsonl to s3. Example harness cmd: `rw-bench run --model rdx-13b --seq 1024 --qps 80 --dur 30m --telemetry schema_v3.json`

kevin @ArborCompute: We can ship probe + wiring PDF. Recommend disabling power smoothing on card firmware for steady measurements — we'll include a firmware toggle. Kit ships week of Jul 5.

ivan (lab-ops): Blocking rack-5 Jul 7-9. Need 3hr install window Jul 6 for probe wiring and PSU checks. Image: redwood-perf-2026-07-01. I'll snapshot pre-run and drop artifacts in s3.

notify-bot: Calendar: "Arbor x Redwood — perf/W calibration" Jul 6 10:00 PT (install), Jul 7 09:00 PT (runs).

sofia (partnerships): Action items:
- mira: open PR with schema_v3.json and harness example (include field names and units)
- ben: upload workload CSV + perf/W calc recipe (instant + steady avg)
- ivan: confirm image, serial access, and add snapshot link to s3
- kevin: confirm probe ETA, wiring PDF, and any recommended card knobs

ben (perf-eng): I'll compute perf/W both raw and normalized-to-TDP, annotate kernel flags and git SHAs. Uploading workload CSV to s3://redwood-perf/interop/arbor/1822223333/workload.csv by EOD Tue.

mira (eng-runtime): ack — opening PR now. Will include a small parser for thermal events and a boot-time artifact collector.

kevin @ArborCompute: ack — kit ETA Jul 4 (arrive Jul 5). Sending wiring PDF to dana@redwood. Firmware toggle note included.

ivan (lab-ops): image confirmed, serial console enabled. Snapshot: s3://redwood-perf/interop/arbor/1822223333/snapshot.tar.gz

sofia (partnerships): Great. After runs we'll draft a 2-paragraph marketplace blurb and route for legal/marketing signoff before publishing. Using this thread for quick updates only.

ben (perf-eng): one last ask: include per-card thermal counters and a column for throttle_reason in final csv. Helps attribution.

mira (eng-runtime): adding thermal counters and throttle_reason boolean to schema. Will log runtime and kernel git SHAs for reproducibility.

sofia (partnerships): Thanks all — closing loop until install.
